title: OpenText Consultant
description:
OpenText VIM/OCR Expert - Remote working - English Speaking


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of OpenText VIM for automated vendor invoice processing.
  • Configure and support invoice capture, OCR extraction, validation, workflow routing, and posting to SAP FI/MM .
  • Implement and optimize OpenText Intelligent Capture Center (ICC) or equivalent OCR tools for invoice data extraction.
  • Configure VIM Document Processing (DP), exception handling, and workflow approvals .
  • Integrate VIM with SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable, PO invoice processing, and vendor master data .
  • Support ArchiveLink/Content Server integration for document storage and retrieval.
  • Assist with system testing, integration testing, and go-live readiness .
  • Troubleshoot issues related to OCR extraction, invoice matching, workflow processing, and FI posting errors .
  • Support go-live and hypercare activities, including improving touchless invoice processing rates.

title: Administrador de Dados Júnior
description:
• Experiência em banco de dados Oracle e SQL Server, versionamento de schemas e administração de grandes bases transacionais.
  • Projetar modelos de dados (lógico e físico);
  • Acompanhar as equipes de desenvolvimento durante a modelagem de dados.
  • Avaliar modelos de dados produzidos pelas equipes de desenvolvimento.
  • Criação e manutenção de índices.
  • Versionamento de scripts no Git ou similar.


O que esperamos de você

  • Educação Requerida: Graduação em Sistemas de Informação / Ciências da Computação ou similar.
  • Experiência com modelagem relacional / multi-dimensional e ferramentas Case.
  • Conhecimento de Structured Query Language (SQL).
  • Experiência com Banco de Dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de BI, ETL, Data Warehouse.
  • Vivência com gerenciamento de versão para artefatos de Banco de Dados.
  • Vivência em ambiente Ágil e cultura DevOps.


Desejamos também

  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Conhecimento de rotinas de manutenção e sustentação de banco de dados como Backup, Restore, atualização e migração de ambientes dentre outras.
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados não-relacionais (MongoDB, Cassandra).


Esta posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões e esteja há 24km do escritório da Unisys (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá vir presencial 3 vezes na semana.

  • Habilidade para comunicar problemas de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender novas metodologias e ferramentas.
  • Curiosidade, e atenção à detalhes


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER


  • Experiência em testes de software aplicados ao mercado de seguros.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de documentação de testes, como TestRail ou similares.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Analista de QA
description:
Buscamos um profissional com forte viés analítico e orientação a dados , capaz de garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados que alimentam nossas soluções.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores e Product Owners desde o refinamento técnico
  • Identificar, documentar e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das inconsistências e falhas identificadas nos processos e fluxos
  • Garantir a manutenção e evolução do nosso framework de automação
  • Promover a cultura de qualidade dentro do squad, disseminando boas práticas


Competências técnicas essenciais:

  • SQL para consulta, validação e auditoria de dados
  • JSON para análise e validação de payloads em integrações e APIs
  • Python para automação de validações e manipulação de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear e documentar processos de dados (pipelines, fluxos de ingestão, transformação e entrega)


Competências comportamentais:

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes na gestão de processos e casos de teste
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação com clientes internos e externos sobre qualidade, requisitos e inconsistências de dados
  • Perfil investigativo, proativo e orientado à resolução de problemas


Desejável:

  • Experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em SEO — faz parte do plano de desenvolvimento da equipe para os próximos ciclos, sendo um diferencial, mas não bloqueante para a contratação
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do ecossistema de dados (ex: dbt, Great Expectations, Postman, ferramentas de observabilidade de dados)


Remuneração e Modelo:

  • Modelo de Contratação: CLT ou PJ

title: Analista Funcional Pleno Dynamics 365
description:
Especialistas em tecnologias e plataformas para gestão para negócios, somos reconhecidamente, uma das principais provedoras de soluções Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM no Brasil.

Com foco na inovação e comprometidos com a qualidade, nossos projetos já ajudaram muitas empresas a mudarem o futuro das pessoas.

Nossa cultura está baseada em entregar inovação e criatividade com alta performance trazendo para o time, profissionais que possuam espírito inovador, alma empreendedora e obsessão em evoluir.

Então, vamos realizar juntos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de perfil funcional para condução de levantamentos, mapeamento de processos, documentação funcional e interface com o cliente ao longo do projeto.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos funcionais junto ao cliente;
  • Mapear processos de negócio e traduzi‑los para o Dynamics 365;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional (requisitos, fluxos, histórias);
  • Apoiar o time técnico no entendimento das regras de negócio;
  • Participar de validações, testes e homologações com o cliente;
  • Atuar como ponto focal funcional no projeto.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência prévia atuando como analista funcional em Dynamics 365;
  • Conhecimento dos módulos de Sales e/ou Customer Service;
  • Vivência em projetos de CRM ou soluções corporativas;
  • Capacidade de modelagem de processos e regras de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com Dataverse e conceitos da Power Platform.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Excelente comunicação com clientes e times internos;
  • Perfil analítico e organizado;
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões e workshops;
  • Senso de prioridade e foco em geração de valor para o cliente.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Cartão benefício Flash com vale refeição de R$30,00/dia;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino para graduação e especializações;
  • Assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação;
  • Incentivo para educação (idiomas);
  • Aplicativos de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Parceria com o SESC;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto;
  • Treinamentos e Certificação;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e feedback 1:1


Na Bizapp apoiamos a igualdade de gênero, cor, idade, orientação sexual, crença e deficiência. Por isso, todos os candidatos são considerados igualmente em nossos processos.

title: DBA Oracle Sênior
description:
• Educação Requerida: Sistemas de Informação / Ciências da Computação ou similar (mínimo de 4 anos da graduação).
  • Experiência em ambientes complexos de grandes volumes de dados e ferramentas para soluções de missão-crítica.
  • Experiência em administração de bancos de dados em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento de rotinas de manutenção e sustentação de banco de dados como Backup, Restore, atualização e migração de ambientes dentre outras.
  • Vivência com gerenciamento de versão para artefatos de Banco de Dados.
  • Atuação comprovada com conceitos de modelagem relacional / multi-dimensional aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento e manutenção.
  • Experiência com Ferramentas de BI, ETL, Data Warehouse.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mascaramento de dados e ferramentas Case.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização de dados gerenciais como Power BI, Tableau, Qlinkview ou similar.
  • Experiência com metodologia ITIL de gestão de mudanças.
  • Experiência em análise de performance de ambientes de banco de dados.


Habilidades desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento dos princípios do security by design e LGPD
  • Gestão da informação aplicando conceitos de Data Quality.
  • Pensamento arquitetural e melhores práticas de performance em bancos de dados.
  • Integração entre sistemas multiplataforma.
  • Conhecimento de BD SQL Server
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados não-relacionais (MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Certificações Oracle são um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de computação em nuvem.
  • Habilidade de explorar e propor soluções conectadas ao negócio.
  • Possuir inglês intermediário.

Soft Skills que buscamos neste perfil:

  • Possuir capacidade de priorizar o seu próprio trabalho a partir das linhas gerais definidas pela equipe e de feedbacks recebidos dos principais stakeholders.
  • Ser flexível, colaborativo e proativo.
  • Ser curioso, com muita vontade de experimentar e aprender coisas novas;
  • Possuir senso de organização e atenção a qualidade de suas entregas;
  • Empatia e capacidade de colaborar em equipe;
  • Buscar aprendizado constantemente.


Esta posição é remota, porém, caso você resida na cidade de São Paulo e regiões e esteja há 24km do escritório da Unisys (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá vir presencial 3 vezes na semana.

title: Senior QA Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Senior QA Data Engineer , who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

Lead QA initiatives for one or more projects, including planning, execution, and reporting.

Develop, maintain, and execute automated and manual test scripts, leveraging tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing frameworks.

Mentor and guide junior QA team members, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

Analyze testing results, identify issues, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.

Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies, providing insights on testing progress and quality metrics. Identify scenarios suitable for automation, optimize testing strategies, and improve testing efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and Stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.

Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring quick resolution and continuous improvement. Stay updated on industry best practices, testing tools, and methodologies.


Technical Skills & Knowledge:

Testing Strategies: Expertise in functional, integration, unit, regression, and exploratory testing. Automation & Scripting: Proficient in Java and Python; experience with Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing. Frameworks & Tools: Experience in creating custom test frameworks; familiarity with GitHub Copilot for automation.

Methodologies: Agile/Scrum experience, ISTQB CTFL certification is a plus.

Testing Approaches: Knowledge of BDD, web testing, and performance testing. Version Control & Management: Proficient in JIRA and GitHub. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Strong problem-solving abilities with a creative and efficient mindset. Ability to work independently, self-manage, and adapt quickly to changing priorities. Team-oriented, collaborative, and proactive in seeking solutions and improvements. Organized and capable of planning testing activities effectively. Deep understanding of the product’s purpose and how testing contributes to overall quality. Qualifications: 3-5 years of experience in software QA or related fields. Advanced knowledge of testing tools and automation frameworks. ISTQB CTFL certification (preferred). Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and best practices


Mandatory Skills:

  • SQL
  • Python programming
  • Robot Framework -
  • Automate testing
  • BDD


Data Pipelines: Experience validating and testing ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.

Databases: Strong understanding of SQL and experience working with relational and/or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar).

Data Processing: Familiarity with data transformation tools and frameworks (e.g., Python-based processing, Spark concepts, or equivalent).

Data Quality: Ability to define and implement data quality checks, reconciliation rules, and monitoring for anomalies.

APIs & Integration: Experience testing data integrations, APIs, and downstream consumers (dashboards, reports, or analytics use cases).

Cloud & DevOps (Nice to Have): Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines supporting data and test automation workflows.

title: Fullstack QA Engineer
description:
Must haves

  • 5+ years of overall experience
  • Web Testing Experience/SQL Experience
  • Knowledge of Python and Playwright
  • Experience with manual API Testing (Insomnia is a plus)
  • Experience with integration testing
  • Attention to details and ability to debug complex issues
  • Experience with data validation/schema checking
  • Expert with JIRA/Confluence
  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English, daily communication with US-team members


As a plus

  • Knowledge Robot Framework
  • Nice to have experience with AWS Athena and Snowflake
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines is a plus


Key responsibilities

  • Review and analyze requirements, specifications, and technical design documents while providing timely feedback.
  • Develop detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
  • Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet client needs.
  • Estimate, prioritize, plan, and coordinate testing activities.
  • Identify and report issues found, then verify that issues are resolved.
  • Liaise with internal teams (e.g. developers and product managers) to identify system requirements.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions from a testability perspective.
  • Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts.
  • Stay up-to-date with new testing tools and test strategies.
  • Helping drive quality from conception to finished product.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Account Manager
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint.
  • Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution.
  • Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations.
  • Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template.
  • Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success.
  • Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there.
  • High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally.
  • Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required.
  • Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.


Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with project management or CRM tools.
  • Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients.
  • Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Reports to the Director of Accounts
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We’re supporting a client building a high-impact platform , and they’re looking for an Automation Engineer to take ownership of their testing capability.


This is a long-term contract (through to end of 2026) , ideal for someone looking for stability while working on a complex, real-world system.


What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and building automated test frameworks using TestComplete
  • Creating and maintaining smoke, regression, and integration test suites
  • Integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins)
  • Automating from existing manual test cases (JIRA/Rally) with full traceability
  • Driving quality improvements across the release lifecycle


What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience with TestComplete
  • Experience with JavaScript, Python, or VBScript for automation
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD (Jenkins)
  • Experience with API and system-level testing
  • Ability to work across Windows and Linux environments


Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare / clinical systems (HL7)
  • JSON validation, SMTP/WCTP protocols
  • Exposure to WebLogic, VMware, Apache


The details

  • Contract until December 2026
  • Rate: $20 per hour
  • Long-term, stable project environment

description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

100% Remota

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e ciclo de desenvolvimento de software

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re Nooro - a fast-growing app company operating alongside a highly profitable eCommerce business, doing over $100M per year. 


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We need a Jr. Media Buyer to manage day-to-day campaign operations in our Meta ad account under the direction of our senior media buyer.


This is primarily a creative testing execution role. You will be inside Ads Manager daily building out new creative tests, launching ads, managing budgets, QA-ing everything before publish, and reporting on performance. Expect 90% of your time to be setting up and managing creative tests across client accounts.


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


RESPONSIBILITES

•    Build and launch new creative tests across multiple client accounts — new ad variations, copy iterations, hook tests, format tests (static, video, carousel, UGC), and angle tests

•    Structure creative tests properly within campaign architecture (CBO, ABO, ASC, Advantage+ Shopping) based on the testing framework set by the senior buyer

•    QA every ad before publish: UTM parameters, creative assets, copy, placements, audience targeting, conversion events, and tracking verification

•    Monitor Advantage+ Creative Enhancements and platform-level automation settings, applying the correct protocol per client and creative type

•    Execute daily budget adjustments, ad toggling, and bid changes based on performance thresholds

•    Pull and organize creative performance data for weekly reporting (ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, Thumbstop, Hold Rate) so winning and losing creatives are clearly identified

•    Flag anomalies: spend pacing issues, delivery problems, rejected ads, pixel firing errors

•    Communicate async via Slack with clear status updates, questions, and blockers


REQUIREMENTS

• 6+ months hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager (not boosted posts, not watching courses — actually building and managing campaigns)

• Understands campaign structures: CBO vs. ABO, broad vs. interest targeting, dynamic creative vs. standard ads

• Experience setting up creative tests and knows how to isolate variables (hook, angle, format, copy) without muddying results

• Familiar with Meta Pixel, CAPI, and event-based conversion tracking

• Can navigate Business Manager: ad accounts, pixels, product catalogs, partner access

• Detail-oriented — the kind of person who double-checks UTMs and preview links before anything goes live

• Reliable async communicator. PST working hours required.


NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

• Experience with DTC/ecommerce brands

• Basic understanding of landing page CRO and how it connects to ad performance

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and Power BI for data pulls and reporting


This is a straightforward execution role with clear systems and expectations. We value precision, speed, and reliability.


Apply ONLY if you're looking for a full-time role in the long run, not a quick gig.

title: Administrador de sistema e banco de dados
description:
Administrador de Banco de Dados

Buscamos um Administrador de Banco de Dados qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve possuir sólida experiência em MongoDB e Redis, e conhecimentos em PostgreSQL serão considerados um diferencial. Esta é uma oportunidade incrível para um profissional que deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, contribuindo para a performance e segurança de nossos sistemas de dados.


Responsabilidades:

- Administrar e otimizar bancos de dados MongoDB e Redis, garantindo alta disponibilidade e desempenho.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento na modelagem de dados e na criação de consultas eficientes.

- Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de backup e recuperação de dados para assegurar a integridade das informações.

- Monitorar o desempenho dos bancos de dados, realizando tuning e ajustes conforme necessário.

- Garantir a segurança dos dados, implementando políticas de acesso e controle de usuários.

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e melhores práticas relacionadas à administração de bancos de dados.

- Resolver problemas de banco de dados de maneira proativa, minimizando o tempo de inatividade.


Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada em administração de banco de dados MongoDB e Redis.

- Conhecimento prático em PostgreSQL será um diferencial.

- Habilidade em otimização de desempenho e troubleshooting.

- Familiaridade com práticas de backup, recuperação de dados e segurança.

- Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e se comunicar efetivamente com diferentes áreas da empresa.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem e soluções de banco de dados como serviço (DBaaS).

- Conhecimento em outras tecnologias de banco de dados NoSQL e relacionais.

title: Performance Marketing  Specialist
description:
Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD) - Brazil
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. title: Product / Marketing Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Product/Marketing Analyst to work on configuring and managing offers and partners within our PRM (Partner Relationship Management) system, ensuring the efficient execution of initiatives requested by the operator Vivo and coordinating activities with internal departments.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


· Configure offers and partners in the PRM system.


· Receive, analyze, and manage requests for new initiatives (new offers, changes, or the addition of new partners) from Vivo.


· Create status presentations and reports to track the initiatives.


· Coordinate with internal departments such as Development, Support, and QA as needed.


· Perform functional testing of offers prior to launch, ensuring quality and compliance.


· Support communication and alignment with internal and external stakeholders.


REQUIREMENTS:


· Experience in digital product management or product marketing.


· Knowledge of partner management platforms or CRM.


· Ability to create clear and objective presentations and reports.


· Ability to coordinate between technical and business departments.


· Organization and attention to detail to ensure quality in deliverables.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:


· Experience in the telecom sector or with B2B2C platforms.


· Familiarity with partner integration processes and offer configuration.


· Basic knowledge of functional testing and QA tools.


· Fluency in Spanish.



ABOUT THE COMPANY:


TIMWETECH, a Portuguese multinational, is a global provider of technology solutions, operating in 80 countries through 30 offices and serving our clients with a diverse portfolio organized into three vertical sectors: B2B2C Platform Services, Digital Marketing, and Fintech.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

Lilo Social is seeking a Creative Strategist to lead performance-driven creative strategy across a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth.


What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations
  • Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns
  • Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction
  • Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed


Responsibilities

  • Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies
  • Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas
  • Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria
  • Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts
  • Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution
  • Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives
  • Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks
  • Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates
  • Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients
  • Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities
  • Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions


Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience
  • Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred)
  • Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis
  • Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction
  • Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities
  • Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance
  • Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion


Nice to Have

  • Client-facing experience including presenting strategy, leading client calls, and confidently pushing for action based on data and creative insights
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing frameworks to improve post-click performance
  • Experience building creative playbooks, training materials, or onboarding systems for creative teams
  • Familiarity with additional paid social platforms including TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or Pinterest Ads
  • Background in agency environments managing multiple client accounts with varying needs and timelines


Compensation and Benefits

  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere working US hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth.


What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations
  • Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns
  • Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction
  • Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed


Responsibilities

  • Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies
  • Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas
  • Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria
  • Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts
  • Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution
  • Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives
  • Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks
  • Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates
  • Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients
  • Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities
  • Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions


Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience
  • Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred)
  • Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis
  • Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction
  • Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities
  • Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance
  • Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion


Nice to Have

  • Client-facing experience including presenting strategy, leading client calls, and confidently pushing for action based on data and creative insights
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing frameworks to improve post-click performance
  • Experience building creative playbooks, training materials, or onboarding systems for creative teams
  • Familiarity with additional paid social platforms including TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or Pinterest Ads
  • Background in agency environments managing multiple client accounts with varying needs and timelines


Compensation and Benefits

  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere working US hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Ad Operations Specialist
description:
Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist



AdLib is looking for a DSP Ad Operations and Trafficking Specialist to support our brand and agency partners by ensuring flawless campaign setup, trafficking, QA, and delivery execution across multiple

programmatic platforms. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience implementing and

maintaining campaigns across DSPs like BeesWax, Yahoo, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, and similar.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Execute end-to-end trafficking and setup across multiple DSPs, including QA and launch

readiness.

• Manage pacing and delivery to ensure budgets and flight dates remain on track.

• Perform detailed QA across targeting, creatives, tracking, and measurement prior to launch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, tracking errors, creative rejections, and platform-level discrepancies.

• Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented

correctly and on time.

• Maintain accurate documentation, naming conventions, and operational workflows across platforms.

• Support reporting needs by ensuring campaign data is consistent and properly structured.

• Stay up to date on DSP requirements, ad operations best practices, and evolving programmatic standards.



Whats You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in ad operations, trafficking, or execution across multiple DSPs (BeesWax, Xandr, Amazon, The Trade Desk, DV360, Moloco, etc.).

• Strong understanding of trafficking workflows, pacing, and QA processes in programmatic

advertising.

• Experience troubleshooting delivery, tracking, and technical issues across platforms.

• Familiarity with analytics and measurement tools such as Northbeam, Triple Whale, Appsflyer, and Google Analytics is a plus.

• Detail-oriented mindset with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active campaigns in a fast-paced, remote work environment.



What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (dependent on region)
  • Fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible, remote-first culture
  • Coworking space allowance
  • Gym membership reimbursement
  • Mobile phone plan reimbursement

Join us at AdLib and help agencies and brands scale their programmatic media buying smarter, faster, and more profitably

  • Atuação e condução técnica de demandas de desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações.
  • Atuação como um representante da área de atuação junto aos clientes internos, equipes técnicas e outros fornecedores do cliente.
  • Acompanhamento, validação das entregas e outras atividades associadas ao serviço.
  • Experiência em programação
  • Participação em todas as cerimônias ágeis do time e do programa e acompanhamento das atividades realizadas pelo time de desenvolvimento;
  • Remoção de impedimentos do time de desenvolvimento nas situações não puderem ser tratadas pelo Agile Master ou ainda no caso de inexistência desse papel no time;
  • Definição e/ou validação da arquitetura técnica dos novos desenvolvimentos,
  • Avaliação da qualidade das aplicações, identificação de GAPs e débitos técnicos, e elaboração de planos de adequação;
  • Elaboração de apresentações, treinamentos e participação em reuniões técnicas que se façam necessárias no ciclo de vida dos produtos mantidos pela equipe;
  • Ter experiência com programação (não vai trabalhar 'codando', mas é necessário ter conhecimento)

  • Graduação completa em qualquer faculdade de TI.

title: Especialista de Sistemas - Product Owner
description:
Atribuições:


  • Traduzir objetivos de negócio e necessidades regulatórias em roadmap, épicos, features e histórias de usuário claras e testáveis.
  • Atuar como ponte entre negócio, tecnologia, risco/compliance, operações e atendimento, garantindo alinhamento e decisões rápidas.
  • Conduzir discovery (entrevistas, dados, jornadas, hipóteses, MVPs) e delivery (priorização, refinamento, aceite, release).
  • Ser dono do backlog: priorizar com base em valor, impacto, risco, dependências e capacidade (ex.: WSJF/RICE).
  • Operar o fluxo no Jira (boards, workflows, automations, dashboards, JQL, métricas), mantendo rastreabilidade e visibilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Facilitar e sustentar rituais ágeis (planning, refinement, daily, review, retro) e promover melhoria contínua do processo do time.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs/OKRs (ativação, conversão, retenção, NPS/CSAT, fraude/chargeback, tempo de ciclo, qualidade).
  • Garantir qualidade do que é entregue: critérios de aceite, DoR/DoD, homologação com stakeholders e gestão de incidentes/bugs prioritários.
  • Requisitos desejáveis: vivência em banco digital/fintech (Pix, onboarding/KYC, cartões, crédito, antifraude), integração via APIs e sqquads multidisciplinares.


Requisitos Necessários:


  • Graduação Completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada
  • Experiência prévia como PO/PM ou em funções similares de gestão de produtos.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e liderança.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos.
  • Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.



*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

description:

title: Growth / BD Manager
description:
Role Summary:

We are looking for a results-oriented BD Manager to develop and maintain relationships with partners and identifying new business opportunities.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities with potential customers and strategic partners.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop and execute effective sales strategies and tactics.
  • Extensive network and strong resource connections in local market (top KOLs, community leaders, etc.), with a proven track record of successful cases.
  • Have verifiable trading volume on another exchange.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify emerging trends and opportunities in the crypto exchange industry.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.Develop and deliver presentations and proposals to potential partners to showcase our products and services.


Job Requirements:

  • Candidates with background in foreign exchange trading, trading funds, and online gambling.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in business development, sales, or related field.
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and closing new business opportunities.
  • Strong knowledge of the crypto exchange industry and market trends.Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish / Portuguese.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships with a range of stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver results under tight deadlines.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


About CoinEx:

Founded in December 2017, CoinEx is a global cryptocurrency exchange under the ViaBTC Group. Available in 18 languages, CoinEx offers products and services that include spot, futures, margin trading, mining, AMM, and CoinEx Dock, providing simple, safe, and reliable crypto trading services for over 10 million users in 200+ countries and regions.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Role Overview

The SAP SD Techno‑Functional Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering SAP Sales & Distribution solutions, along with managing technical enhancements through ABAP knowledge. The role bridges functional expertise with technical capability to support end‑to‑end sales process.


Key Responsibilities


Functional Responsibilities

  • Gather and analyze business requirements related to Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Sales & Distribution processes.
  • Configure SAP SD modules including:
  • Customer Master, Material Master, Pricing, Output Determination
  • Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing
  • Shipping, Credit Management, Returns & Refunds
  • Availability Check (ATP), Intercompany sales, Third‑party sales
  • Design and implement pricing procedures, tax configurations, and condition techniques.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (MM, FI, PP, WM, CRM, TM).
  • Provide support for UAT, SIT, integration testing, and Go-Live.
  • Prepare functional specifications for RICEFW objects.


Technical Responsibilities (Techno‑Functional)

  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to build and enhance custom objects.
  • Ability to debug ABAP code to perform issue analysis.
  • Create Functional Design Documents (FDD), and review Technical Design Documents (TDD).


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

title: Gerente de contas-chave
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Gestor comercial para atender ao canal de Distribuição do ramo farma, com atuação em PA - AP - AM - RR


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável pelo sellin, sellout e gestão de inventário de grupos de distribuidoras parceiras de uma região delimitada;
  • Lidera o desenvolvimento de contas regionais migradas para atendimento via distribuição;
  • Controla os investimentos para sellout para os PDVs não visitados;
  • Maximiza a venda e distribuição de todos os produtos da empresa na região atribuída através do estabelecimento e execução adequada de programas de vendas locais;
  • Responsável por alinhar todas as estratégias nacionais e regionais com os Disty;
  • Treina, desenvolve e acompanha os vendedores terceiros da distribuidora. Estar presente em campo para apoiar a equipe do distribuidor no alcance de suas metas e para acompanhar os concorrentes e a dinâmica do mercado;
  • Realizar análises dos canais de vendas, monitorar o trade e o comportamento do cliente, visando captar continuamente as tendências do mercado para identificar oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de desempenho para identificar oportunidades e gerar insights para melhoria;
  • Assegurar a gestão dos investimentos da área comercial e acompanhar os KPIs financeiros;
  • Monitora a atividade do mercado / varejista para desenvolver as estratégias mais econômicas a fim de impulsionar o volume e a lucratividade por meio de maior penetração e giro;
  • Executa as rotinas desenhadas no programa de excelência (PEX).


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo (engenharias, economia, física, estatísticas, matemática, adm);
  • Experiência como Key Account Manager (Desejável);
  • Desejável experiência com disty semi-exclusivo ou exclusivo no segmento de (higiene e beleza, consumo alimentar ou bebidas);
  • Excel avançado (mandatório);
  • Capacidade analítica e qualidade de decisão (PDCA);
  • Liderança indireta (lidera indiretamente dos RCAs do Disty);
  • Gerencia o conflito;
  • Conhecimento de JBP (Joint Bussines Plan) c/ ScoreCard;
  • Foco em resultados com diligência.·


Informações adicionais

  • Vale refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Auxílio medicamentos.
  • Total Pass


O Grupo NC, em posição de maior conglomerado farmacêutico do Brasil, prioriza a diversidade, inclusão e equidade, valorizando as pessoas e suas histórias. Com a gente, seja quem você realmente é.


#EsseÉoNossoDNA!

title: Consultor SAP PP - Sênior
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor SAP PP para fazer parte do nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores e de grande relevância!


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar os impactos do upgrade do S/4HANA 2025 nos processos do módulo PP.
  • Revisar e validar configurações relacionadas a: Planejamento de Produção, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), Ordens de Produção, Listas Técnicas (BOM) e Roteiros
  • Avaliar impactos dos Simplification Items do S/4HANA, especialmente relacionados a MRP, dados mestres e integrações logísticas.
  • Apoiar e executar testes funcionais (unitários, integrados e UAT) envolvendo cenários produtivos.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com consultores MM, CO, ABAP e BASIS para tratamento de ajustes funcionais e técnicos.
  • Garantir que alterações provenientes de projetos paralelos não comprometam a estabilidade e o planejamento da produção durante o upgrade.
  • Apoiar o cutover funcional e a estabilização dos processos produtivos pós golive.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida como Consultor SAP PP, preferencialmente em ambientes S/4HANA.
  • Vivência em projetos de upgrade SAP, especialmente com impacto em planejamento e execução da produção.
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas SAP para PP no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência na análise de impactos funcionais em ambientes com múltiplas frentes simultâneas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação parttime, com boa organização, autonomia e foco em entregas.


Tipo de Alocação: 100% remoto

Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países.
